_comment_server: Configuration for the LazyIVQueue Admin API and Webhook server.
_comment_security: Restrict access using IPs or authentication headers.
_comment_logging: Log level (e.g. INFO, DEBUG) and whether to output to a log file.
_comment_lists: Priority list of Pokemon to scout. Format: ['1', '3:0'] where '1' = bulbasaur any form. Lower index = higher priority.
_comment_auto_rarity: Auto-rarity selects IV-less wild/nearby_stop sightings after calibration. Admission compares global species/form frequency with self_tuning.iv_baseline_percent (0.03 means 0.03%, not 3%), adjusted by self-tuning. The rarity thresholds below label display/log tiers. IV-known nearby sightings use pinpoint rules instead.
_comment_self_tuning: Self-tuning queue circuit breaker and dynamic load tuning (adjusts auto-rarity filtering during backlogs while keeping scouts active). too_many_workers_percent / too_few_workers_percent define the worker utilization dead band: if awaiting_iv workers stay at/above 50% of concurrency for tuning_interval_seconds the scout percent steps down; at/below 5% it steps up; in between it holds steady.
_comment_koji: Koji API settings for filtering and geofencing.
_comment_scout: Worker thread settings. concurrency is number of workers.
_comment_pinpoint: Pinpoint: scout Pokemon with IVs but an approximate position (nearby_stop at the pokestop, nearby_cell at the S2 cell centre). Select when iv% >= min_iv, iv% <= max_iv, best PvP rank <= pvp_max_rank, or include_ivlist is true and the species/form matches ivlist; null disables an IV/PvP rule. Auto-rarity does not select IV-known targets. Success requires an IV-bearing exact sighting of the same encounter, not a verified despawn timer. hold_seconds gives regular workers a chance first.
_comment_dragonite: Dragonite API credentials for sending IV/cell scout requests. global_rate_limit_monitor (off unless enabled) polls Dragonite's own /global-rate-limit endpoint and resets it if waiters exceeds the threshold; only useful with a MITM that piles up rate-limit waiters.
